title: AFL++ multi-core fuzzing
preconditions: a `@@` file or stdin input contract
steps: Build `AFL_USE_ASAN=1 afl-clang-fast -g -O1 harness.c -o harness` (or instrument the target with `afl-clang-lto`).
Create `in/` seeds; run `afl-fuzz -i in -o out -m none -- ./harness @@` with ASan memory limits disabled.
Add persistent mode with `__AFL_LOOP(1000)` around the parse call for a large speedup.
After discovery, run `afl-cmin -i out/default/queue -o cmin -- ./harness @@` and `afl-tmin` on the crash.
falsifier: No paths after 10 minutes or `afl-fuzz` reports the target is not instrumented.
pitfalls: harness re-execs per input instead of forkserver
